# accounts for parameter

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:accountsForParameter`](gmeow-accountsForParameter.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/accountsForParameter>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The parameter whose omission or approximation is explained by this [`ProjectionLoss`](../classes/gmeow-ProjectionLoss.md). Used by completeness gates to ensure every parameter is representable or accounted for. Range is open in core; domain slices restrict it.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ProjectionLoss`](../classes/gmeow-ProjectionLoss.md) -> [`owl:Thing`](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:accountsForParameter`](gmeow-accountsForParameter.md) from [`gmeow:ProjectionLoss`](../classes/gmeow-ProjectionLoss.md) to [`owl:Thing`](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:ProjectionLoss`](../classes/gmeow-ProjectionLoss.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`gmeow:ProjectionLoss`](../classes/gmeow-ProjectionLoss.md) to name the canonical parameter it omits or approximates — the link that lets the completeness gate pair every dropped parameter with an explicit loss.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for a parameter the notation represents (that is [`gmeow:representableParameter`](gmeow-representableParameter.md)) and avoid leaving a declared loss without an accounted parameter, which defeats the gate.

### How to use

- Point each [`gmeow:ProjectionLoss`](../classes/gmeow-ProjectionLoss.md) at the parameter it explains via [`gmeow:accountsForParameter`](gmeow-accountsForParameter.md); domain slices restrict its open range to their parameter vocabulary.

- ex:lossMicrotiming [`gmeow:accountsForParameter`](gmeow-accountsForParameter.md) ex:microtiming.
